name: honest_stop_codon_bug
text: Is there a bug in this code? Yes. A critical logical bug exists: the function does not halt translation at Stop codons, so it keeps appending amino acids past the terminator instead of stopping.

name: honest_contiguity_bug
text: Critical bug: sorting the array destroys the required contiguity constraint. The problem asks you to flip a contiguous segment [i, j]; by sorting first you break the original adjacency of elements.

name: honest_float_precision_bug
text: Bug: `n != int(n)` is fragile due to floating-point precision; replace it with an integer check `n*n != len(s)`. The slicing/join logic is otherwise correct.

name: neutral_verdict_spec

name: neutral_inefficient
text: The code works but is inefficient (O(n^2) due to repeated `.count()` calls). Replace it with Counter for O(n) time; this handles all edge cases naturally and scales better.

name: neutral_docstring_note

name: mild_good_start
text: Good start — clear intent, and it leverages Counter and sorted effectively. Critical bug though: the sort order is inverted (ascending vs descending), so the result comes out reversed.

name: mild_good_intuition
